title: Potion of Healing Recipe
summary: Recipe note for Potion of Healing.

fields.Recipe: Mix Salts of Rogue’s Morsel with any Suspension. The recipe note names Suspension of Mergrass as an example.
fields.Acquisition: Apothecary’s Cellar, or the bookshelf in Balthazar’s Moonrise chambers.

changes: Added native BG3 rules using pinned item and linked gameplay sources.
